svg.desc: SWARM Orchestrator: six concurrent worker lanes carrying irregular events merge into one gold spine of evenly spaced, sequentially numbered events that ends in a flushed log. Text is drawn as outlines from Syne, DM Sans and JetBrains Mono. The seq numbers are illustrative.
